name: hyperdrain
changelog:
• Direct Graphical Authentication: Resolved updater process management so pkexec/zenity sudo password prompt appears reliably on restart
• Resilient Multi-Threaded Engine: High-speed download optimizations with 6-worker chunking and SQLite WAL state journaling
• Seamless Auto-Restart: Refined update script execution ensuring clean termination and immediate relaunch of the latest binary
